Privacy Policy

Effective Date: November 7, 2026

1. Overview

Gestalt ("we," "our," or "us") provides augmented reality and accessibility tools for experiencing art and public spaces across our iOS app, web experiences and related services (collectively, the "Services"). This Privacy Policy explains what we collect, how we use it, who processes it on our behalf, and the choices you have, including how to delete your account.

2. Information We Collect

a. Account information

You can use most of Gestalt without an account. If you sign in with Apple or Google, we receive your name, email address and an account identifier from that provider. If you use Sign in with Apple and choose to hide your email, we receive a private relay address instead. We keep a contributor profile with your display name, your saved works and private notes, the badges you earn and counts of your contributions.

b. Photos you contribute

When you add an artwork, the photo you take is uploaded with its location, compass heading, image size and the details you enter (such as title, artist and condition). It is reviewed, and if accepted it may be published on the Gestalt map for other visitors to see.

c. Voice recordings

When adding an artwork you can record a spoken description. The microphone is used only while you are recording. The recording is uploaded with your contribution and converted to text, and the transcript is stored with it. Some Gestalt web experiences also invite you to record a spoken response to an artwork; those recordings are converted to text and deleted right after, unless you choose to let us keep them, and phone numbers and email addresses are removed from the text.

d. Location

With your permission, the app uses your location to show art near you, to tell which artwork your camera is pointed at, and, if you turn on nearby alerts, to notify you in the background as you pass public art. Matching your position to nearby artworks happens on your device. To list art near you, the app asks our database for artworks in your general area; we don't store your location from those requests. Your location is saved only with a photo you contribute. You can turn nearby alerts off in the app's Profile screen or in your device settings at any time.

e. Camera

Recognizing an artwork happens on your device: the camera view is compared with artworks using a model that runs on your phone, and those camera frames are not uploaded or stored. A photo leaves your device only when you take one to contribute.

f. Settings and device information

  • Accessibility and app preferences, such as vision mode, text size and audio speed, which are stored on your device
  • Device information (device type, operating system, browser) and basic usage data, such as pages viewed and interactions
  • Messages, feedback or support requests you send us

3. How We Use Information

We use this information to:

  • Identify artworks and tell you about them, including audio descriptions
  • Review contributions, add new artworks to the map and credit first finds
  • Keep your saved collection, notes and badges
  • Send nearby art alerts you have turned on
  • Support accessibility features
  • Improve the accuracy of recognition and descriptions
  • Respond to you when you contact us

4. AI Processing

Some features use artificial intelligence services from Google and Anthropic. They process content on our behalf, only to provide the features described here:

  • Google Cloud Vision analyzes photos you contribute to suggest details such as the title, artist and medium.
  • Google Cloud Speech-to-Text converts your voice recordings to text.
  • Anthropic's Claude screens and organizes spoken responses recorded in Gestalt web experiences, and helps write descriptions of artworks.
  • Google Gemini and Anthropic's Claude help our team write descriptions and audio guides of artworks. The images they receive are of artworks, including contributed photos once they are published.
  • Google Cloud Text-to-Speech reads artwork descriptions aloud.

AI suggestions are shown to you as suggestions, labelled with how confident they are, and you can change them before you send a contribution. We do not use AI to make decisions about you.

5. Sharing of Information

We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising. We share information only with:

  • Service providers who run the Services for us: Google Firebase and Google Cloud (accounts, database, file storage and the AI services above), Anthropic (AI services above), Mapbox (map display, which receives your device's network address and the map area you view) and Hugging Face (which hosts the on-device recognition model your phone downloads)
  • Other visitors, when a contribution of yours is published on the map. Published artworks show the photo and artwork details, not your name or email.
  • Institutional partners (e.g., museums), in aggregated, anonymized form
  • Legal authorities, when required by law

6. Data Retention

We keep your account information, saved works and contributions for as long as you have an account. Voice recordings from Gestalt web experiences are deleted as soon as they are converted to text, unless you choose to let us keep them. When you delete your account, the data described in section 7 is deleted.

7. Deleting Your Account

You can delete your account in the app at any time: open Profile, then Delete account. This permanently deletes your profile, saved works and notes, badges, and your contributions with their photos and voice recordings. Artworks that have already been published stay on the map without any link to you, so that other visitors can still find them. If it has been a while since you last signed in, we will ask you to sign in again first.

You can also ask us to delete your data by writing to hello@gestalt.gallery.

8. Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to:

  • Access or delete your data
  • Opt out of certain data collection, for example by turning off location or nearby alerts
  • Request correction of inaccurate information

To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@gestalt.gallery.

9. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect your data, including encrypted connections and access controls on our databases and file storage.

10. Children's Privacy

Our Services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the effective date above. Continued use of the Services after a change means you accept it.
